page.layout: One printed page: a digitiser's cover sheet (e-rara.ch logo, title block, licence notices and Visual Library logo). No running text, no notes.
page.notes: The page is a digitiser's cover sheet, not printed book text. Omitted as page furniture: the e-rara.ch logo, the Visual Library logo, and the digitiser's banner and licence notices. For reference only, the title block reads: "De satisfactione Christi, pro peccatis nostris iustitiae divinae praestita, inter Michaelem Gittichium socinianum, et Ludovicum Lucium orthodoxum, scholastica & epistolica disceptatio ..." by Gittichius, Michael; Basileae, 1628; Universitätsbibliothek Basel; Shelf Mark Aleph D X 26:2.
